housing.summary: Numbeo reports an August 2026 average of $2,053.64 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in Atlanta's city centre. No reliable source for a typical deposit amount was found, so deposit_months is null. Zillow's Atlanta apartments page is the rental portal.

banking.summary: Chase's official guidance says non-residents may need government-issued photo identification, proof of a U.S. address and an opening deposit; an ITIN may substitute for an SSN if the bank requires a tax number and accepts the substitute.
required_docs: Official government-issued photo identification such as a passport
Proof of U.S. address showing name and address, such as a recent utility bill or employer letter
SSN if required, or an ITIN where accepted as a substitute

schools.summary: Atlanta International School is authorized for the full International Baccalaureate continuum from 3K through grade 12; Atlanta Public Schools provides a city schools directory by IB programme.
curricula: International Baccalaureate: PYP, MYP, DP and CP

legal_admin.summary: The United States has no Atlanta-specific residence registration in the cited source. Most noncitizens must report a change of address to USCIS within 10 days after moving; A and G visa holders and visa-waiver visitors are exempt.
legal_admin.registration_step: Submit the change of address through a USCIS online account or file Form AR-11 by mail within 10 days after moving, unless an exemption applies.

tax_finance.summary: A newcomer who is not eligible for an SSN but needs a U.S. tax-processing number can apply to the IRS for an Individual Taxpayer Identification Number using Form W-7, generally with a federal tax return and proof of foreign status and identity.

transport.summary: MARTA is Atlanta's main cited public-transport network; its standard 30-day pass costs $95.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: Foreign-licence holders need a Georgia licence after becoming residents; applicants from non-reciprocal countries must pass written, road and vision tests. South Korea, with consular certification, and Taiwan have reciprocity. https://dds.georgia.gov/georgia-licenses-ids-and-permits/new-license-id-or-permit/new-georgia-residents-and-out-state-1
transport.healthcare_registration: Eligible newcomers can create a Health Insurance Marketplace account, submit an application to determine eligibility for a Marketplace plan, Medicaid or CHIP, then enroll and pay any required premium. https://www.healthcare.gov/quick-guide/getting-marketplace-health-insurance/
